name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi ~Yomawari Sensei Hen~
original_name: JKと淫行教師～夜回り先生編～
source:
The main character is a teacher. One night, he finds a girl in the town. According to her, she doesn't want to go back home because her mother recently got remarried. He takes her to his house, but she seems to have a cold.... After she takes medicine, she soon falls asleep.... He gets sexually excited to see her defenseless body....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角是一位老师。一天晚上，他在镇上找到了一位女孩。据她说，她不想回家，因为她母亲最近再婚了。他带她到自己家，她似乎感冒了……吃药后，很快就睡着了……看到她毫无防备的身体，他兴奋不已……

[来自工口游戏商店]
